data.description:
Write failing tests for the sample-ack mode of preconditions-ack (--sample-ack --class=<degradation_type>) before it is implemented.

## Testing Mode: RED

Depends on: T3 (7c56-5d9a-562f-49ea) — builds on same TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR fixture pattern.

Target feature: `dso preconditions-ack <story_id> --sample-ack --class=<degradation_type> --if-skipped "<rationale>"`

This mode applies when a degradation class has >=4 entries. It selects exactly 3 decision_ids deterministically using SHA256 of sorted decision_ids, requires --if-skipped validation for each of the 3, writes one ACK event with sampled_set populated.

## Files to Modify

- CREATE `tests/scripts/test-preconditions-ack-sample.sh` (executable)
- MODIFY `.test-index` (add RED marker)

## SHA256 Determinism Algorithm (document in test comments)

Given N decision_ids in class:
1. Sort decision_ids lexicographically
2. Join with newline: printf '%s\n' "${sorted[@]}"
3. SHA256 the joined string: digest=$(printf '%s\n' "${sorted[@]}" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)
4. Convert first 8 hex chars to decimal: seed=$(printf '%d' 0x${digest:0:8})
5. Select index i1 = seed % N; remove that element; select i2 = (seed >> 8) % (N-1); remove; select i3 = (seed >> 16) % (N-2)
6. sampled_set = [decision_ids[i1], decision_ids[i2], decision_ids[i3]] (in order of selection)

Test fixtures must specify exact input decision_ids so expected selection is pre-computable. Compute expected selection offline and hardcode in test assertions.

## Fixture: 4 Decision IDs

decision_ids: ["sess:aaa", "sess:bbb", "sess:ccc", "sess:ddd"]
Use python3 in test setup to pre-compute expected 3 selected IDs with the above algorithm, then assert the ACK file's sampled_set matches.

(The test can compute expected selection at runtime using the same algorithm — no hardcoding needed if the algorithm is deterministic.)

## 5 Test Functions

1. `test_sample_ack_selects_exactly_3` — 4 decision_ids in class → ACK sampled_set has exactly 3 elements
2. `test_sample_ack_selection_is_deterministic` — run sample-ack twice on same input → same sampled_set both times
3. `test_sample_ack_rejects_class_with_fewer_than_4` — 3 decision_ids in class → exits 1 with message indicating class too small for sample-ack
4. `test_sample_ack_ack_file_has_sampled_set_populated` — sampled_set in ACK file is an array (not null)
5. `test_sample_ack_remainder_absorbed_only_when_all_3_pass` — provide invalid rationale for one of the 3 selected → exits 1 (rationale must pass for all 3 selected); no ACK file written

For T5, the PRECONDITIONS fixture in TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR must have data.degradation_class or similar field that groups decision_ids by class. Use: `data: {degradation: true, decision_ids: ["sess:aaa","sess:bbb","sess:ccc","sess:ddd"], degradation_class: "review_gate"}`.

## .test-index RED Marker

Append this exact line to `.test-index`:
```
plugins/dso/scripts/preconditions-ack.sh:tests/scripts/test-preconditions-ack-sample.sh [test_sample_ack_selects_exactly_3] [test_sample_ack_selection_is_deterministic] [test_sample_ack_rejects_class_with_fewer_than_4] [test_sample_ack_ack_file_has_sampled_set_populated] [test_sample_ack_remainder_absorbed_only_when_all_3_pass]
```

## Acceptance Criteria

### Universal
- Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]  (RED state)
- Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

### Task-Specific
- Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-preconditions-ack-sample.sh
- Verify: python3 -c "c=open('tests/scripts/test-preconditions-ack-sample.sh').read(); [__import__('sys').exit(1) for fn in ['test_sample_ack_selects_exactly_3','test_sample_ack_selection_is_deterministic','test_sample_ack_rejects_class_with_fewer_than_4','test_sample_ack_ack_file_has_sampled_set_populated','test_sample_ack_remainder_absorbed_only_when_all_3_pass'] if fn not in c]"
- Verify: python3 -c "c=open('.test-index').read(); exit(0 if 'test-preconditions-ack-sample.sh' in c and 'test_sample_ack_selects_exactly_3' in c else 1)"
- Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-ack-sample.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]
data.title: RED: Write failing tests for sample-ack deterministic selection
